en: Job 40

p.src: 1  Moreover the LORD answered Job,

en: Moreover the LORD answered Job,
u.src: 1  Moreover the LORD answered Job,

p.src: 2  “Shall he who argues contend with the Almighty? He who argues with God, let him answer it.”

en: “Shall he who argues contend with the Almighty? He who argues with God, let him answer it.”
u.src: 2  “Shall he who argues contend with the Almighty? He who argues with God, let him answer it.”

p.src: 3  Then Job answered the LORD,

en: Then Job answered the LORD,
u.src: 3  Then Job answered the LORD,

p.src: 4  “Behold, I am of small account. What will I answer you? I lay my hand on my mouth.

en: “Behold, I am of small account. What will I answer you? I lay my hand on my mouth.
u.src: 4  “Behold, I am of small account. What will I answer you? I lay my hand on my mouth.

p.src: 5  I have spoken once, and I will not answer; Yes, twice, but I will proceed no further.”

en: I have spoken once, and I will not answer; Yes, twice, but I will proceed no further.”
u.src: 5  I have spoken once, and I will not answer; Yes, twice, but I will proceed no further.”

p.src: 6  Then the LORD answered Job out of the whirlwind:

en: Then the LORD answered Job out of the whirlwind:
u.src: 6  Then the LORD answered Job out of the whirlwind:

p.src: 7  “Now brace yourself like a man. I will question you, and you will answer me.

en: “Now brace yourself like a man. I will question you, and you will answer me.
u.src: 7  “Now brace yourself like a man. I will question you, and you will answer me.

p.src: 8  Will you even annul my judgment? Will you condemn me, that you may be justified?

en: Will you even annul my judgment? Will you condemn me, that you may be justified?
u.src: 8  Will you even annul my judgment? Will you condemn me, that you may be justified?

p.src: 9  Or do you have an arm like God? Can you thunder with a voice like him?

en: Or do you have an arm like God? Can you thunder with a voice like him?
u.src: 9  Or do you have an arm like God? Can you thunder with a voice like him?

p.src: 10  “Now deck yourself with excellency and dignity. Array yourself with honor and majesty.

en: “Now deck yourself with excellency and dignity. Array yourself with honor and majesty.
u.src: 10  “Now deck yourself with excellency and dignity. Array yourself with honor and majesty.

p.src: 11  Pour out the fury of your anger. Look at everyone who is proud, and bring him low.

en: Pour out the fury of your anger. Look at everyone who is proud, and bring him low.
u.src: 11  Pour out the fury of your anger. Look at everyone who is proud, and bring him low.

p.src: 12  Look at everyone who is proud, and humble him. Crush the wicked in their place.

en: Look at everyone who is proud, and humble him. Crush the wicked in their place.
u.src: 12  Look at everyone who is proud, and humble him. Crush the wicked in their place.

p.src: 13  Hide them in the dust together. Bind their faces in the hidden place.

en: Hide them in the dust together. Bind their faces in the hidden place.
u.src: 13  Hide them in the dust together. Bind their faces in the hidden place.

p.src: 14  Then I will also admit to you that your own right hand can save you.

en: Then I will also admit to you that your own right hand can save you.
u.src: 14  Then I will also admit to you that your own right hand can save you.

p.src: 15  “See now behemoth, which I made as well as you. He eats grass as an ox.

en: “See now behemoth, which I made as well as you. He eats grass as an ox.
u.src: 15  “See now behemoth, which I made as well as you. He eats grass as an ox.

p.src: 16  Look now, his strength is in his thighs. His force is in the muscles of his belly.

en: Look now, his strength is in his thighs. His force is in the muscles of his belly.
u.src: 16  Look now, his strength is in his thighs. His force is in the muscles of his belly.

p.src: 17  He moves his tail like a cedar. The sinews of his thighs are knit together.

en: He moves his tail like a cedar. The sinews of his thighs are knit together.
u.src: 17  He moves his tail like a cedar. The sinews of his thighs are knit together.

p.src: 18  His bones are like tubes of bronze. His limbs are like bars of iron.

en: His bones are like tubes of bronze. His limbs are like bars of iron.
u.src: 18  His bones are like tubes of bronze. His limbs are like bars of iron.

p.src: 19  He is the chief of the ways of God. He who made him gives him his sword.

en: He is the chief of the ways of God. He who made him gives him his sword.
u.src: 19  He is the chief of the ways of God. He who made him gives him his sword.

p.src: 20  Surely the mountains produce food for him, where all the animals of the field play.

en: Surely the mountains produce food for him, where all the animals of the field play.
u.src: 20  Surely the mountains produce food for him, where all the animals of the field play.

p.src: 21  He lies under the lotus trees, in the covert of the reed, and the marsh.

en: He lies under the lotus trees, in the covert of the reed, and the marsh.
u.src: 21  He lies under the lotus trees, in the covert of the reed, and the marsh.

p.src: 22  The lotuses cover him with their shade. The willows of the brook surround him.

en: The lotuses cover him with their shade. The willows of the brook surround him.
u.src: 22  The lotuses cover him with their shade. The willows of the brook surround him.

p.src: 23  Behold, if a river overflows, he doesn’t tremble. He is confident, though the Jordan swells even to his mouth.

en: Behold, if a river overflows, he doesn’t tremble. He is confident, though the Jordan swells even to his mouth.
u.src: 23  Behold, if a river overflows, he doesn’t tremble. He is confident, though the Jordan swells even to his mouth.

p.src: 24  Shall any take him when he is on the watch, or pierce through his nose with a snare?

en: Shall any take him when he is on the watch, or pierce through his nose with a snare?
u.src: 24  Shall any take him when he is on the watch, or pierce through his nose with a snare?
